re_new.brief: 分配并初始化一个正则 AST 节点 / Allocate and initialise a regex AST node

params.type: 节点类型（`RE_CHAR` 等）/ Node type such as `RE_CHAR`

re_new.return: 新的模式节点 / The new pattern node
re_new.note: 节点从 arena 分配并清零，`max` 初始化为 1、`greedy` 为 1 / The node is arena-allocated and zeroed with `max` 1 and `greedy` 1

re_add.brief: 把子节点追加到父节点的孩子表 / Append a child node to a parent's child list

params.kid: 要追加的子节点 / Child node to append

re_add.note: 每次追加都另分配一份更大的孩子数组再拷贝 / Each append allocates a larger child array and copies the old pointers

re_add_range.brief: 向字符类追加一个码点区间 / Append a code-point range to a character class

params.lo: 区间下界（含）/ Inclusive lower bound
params.hi: 区间上界（含）/ Inclusive upper bound

re_add_range.note: 区间数达到 `RE_MAX_RANGES` 后静默丢弃 / Ranges are silently dropped once `RE_MAX_RANGES` is reached

re_utf8.brief: 从模式串当前位置解码一个 UTF-8 码点 / Decode one UTF-8 code point at the pattern cursor

params.rp: 正则解析器（游标前进）/ Regex parser, whose cursor advances

re_utf8.return: 解码出的码点；非法首字节返回 `0xFFFD` / The decoded code point, or `0xFFFD` for an illegal lead byte
re_utf8.note: 游标越过串尾时被夹到 `len` / The cursor is clamped to `len` when it would overshoot

re_hex.brief: 读取定长十六进制数字 / Read a fixed number of hexadecimal digits

params.rp: 正则解析器（游标前进）/ Regex parser, whose cursor advances
params.digits: 期望读取的数字个数 / Number of digits expected

re_hex.return: 读到的十六进制值 / The hexadecimal value read
re_hex.note: 遇到非十六进制字符或串尾提前停止 / Stops early on a non-hex character or the end of the pattern

re_add_class_escapes.brief: 展开 `\d \D \w \W \s \S` 简写类为码点区间 / Expand a `\d \D \w \W \s \S` shorthand class into code-point ranges

params.cls: inout:接收展开区间的字符类节点 / Character-class node receiving the ranges
params.e: 转义字符 / The escape character

re_add_class_escapes.return: 确为简写类并已追加区间返回 1，否则返回 0 / 1 when `e` was a shorthand class and ranges were added, otherwise 0

re_escape_literal.brief: 把单字符转义映射为字面码点 / Map a single-character escape to its literal code point

params.e: 转义字符 / The escape character

re_escape_literal.return: 对应的码点（`\n`、`\t`、`\r`、`\f`、`\v`、`\0` 等）/ The matching code point for `\n`, `\t`, `\r`, `\f`, `\v`, `\0` and friends
re_escape_literal.note: 未知转义按原字符返回 / An unknown escape falls back to the raw character

re_escape.brief: 解析反斜杠后的转义，区分类转义与字面字符 / Parse an escape after a backslash, telling class escapes from literal characters

params.rp: 正则解析器（游标前进）/ Regex parser, whose cursor advances
params.cls: inout:接收类转义区间的字符类节点 / Character-class node receiving class-escape ranges
params.lit: out:接收字面码点（`\u`/`\x` 与单字符转义）/ Receives the literal code point for `\u`, `\x` and single-character escapes

re_escape.return: 是类转义返回 1（填充 `cls`），是字面转义返回 0（填充 `*lit`）/ 1 for a class escape filling `cls`, 0 for a literal escape filling `*lit`

re_parse_class.brief: 解析字符类 `[...]` / Parse a character class `[...]`

params.rp: 正则解析器（游标位于 `[` 之后）/ Regex parser with the cursor just past `[`

re_parse_class.return: 新建的 `RE_CLASS` 节点 / The new `RE_CLASS` node
re_parse_class.details: 支持开头 `^` 取反、`a-z` 区间、`\` 转义与简写类；区间两端可各为码点或转义。| Supports a leading `^` negation, `a-z` ranges, `\` escapes and shorthand classes, with either range endpoint usable as a code point or escape.

re_isdigit.brief: 判断字符是否为十进制数字 / Test whether a character is a decimal digit

params.c: 待测字符 / Character to test

re_isdigit.return: 是 `0`..`9` 返回 1 / 1 when the character is `0`..`9`

re_parse_braces.brief: 解析 `{n}` / `{n,}` / `{n,m}` 量词范围 / Parse a `{n}` / `{n,}` / `{n,m}` quantifier range

params.rp: 正则解析器（游标前进）/ Regex parser, whose cursor advances
params.out_min: out:接收最小重复次数 / Receives the minimum repeat count
params.out_max: out:接收最大重复次数（`RE_INF` 表示无上限）/ Receives the maximum repeat count, `RE_INF` when unbounded

re_parse_braces.return: 格式合法返回 1，否则游标回退并返回 0 / 1 when well-formed, otherwise the cursor is restored and 0 is returned
re_parse_braces.note: `hi` 小于 `lo` 时被抬到 `lo` / A `hi` below `lo` is raised to `lo`

re_parse_group_header.brief: 解析分组前缀，判定分组种类 / Parse a group prefix and classify the group

params.rp: 正则解析器（游标前进）/ Regex parser, whose cursor advances
params.h: out:接收分组头信息（捕获/环视/后顾/否定）/ Receives the header info: capturing, look-around, look-behind and negation

re_parse_group_header.note: 识别 `(?:`、`(?=`、`(?!`、`(?<=`、`(?<!` 与 `(?<name>`；具名组的名字不保留 / Recognises `(?:`, `(?=`, `(?!`, `(?<=`, `(?<!` and `(?<name>`; the name itself is discarded

re_parse_group.brief: 解析一个分组（含具名与非捕获组）/ Parse a group, named and non-capturing included

params.rp: 正则解析器（游标位于 `(`）/ Regex parser with the cursor at `(`

re_parse_group.return: 分组/环视/后顾节点 / The group, look-around or look-behind node
re_parse_group.details: 先读分组头决定节点种类，再以嵌套的并集表达式作为孩子；捕获组按出现顺序编号。| The header decides the node kind and a nested alternation becomes the child; capturing groups are numbered in order of appearance.
re_parse_group.note: 捕获组数量超过 `RE_MAX_GROUPS` 后不再编号但仍会解析 / Beyond `RE_MAX_GROUPS` groups are still parsed but no longer numbered

re_parse_backslash_atom.brief: 解析反斜杠起头的原子 / Parse a backslash-introduced atom

params.rp: 正则解析器（游标位于 `\`）/ Regex parser with the cursor at `\`

re_parse_backslash_atom.return: 对应的 `RE_CLASS`、`RE_WORDB`、`RE_NWORDB`、`RE_BACKREF` 或 `RE_CHAR` 节点 / The matching `RE_CLASS`, `RE_WORDB`, `RE_NWORDB`, `RE_BACKREF` or `RE_CHAR` node
re_parse_backslash_atom.details: `\b`/`\B` 生成词边界节点，数字生成反向引用，简写类生成 `RE_CLASS`，其余按字面字符处理。| `\b` and `\B` become word-boundary nodes, digits become back-references, shorthand classes become `RE_CLASS` and everything else is a literal character.

re_parse_anchor.brief: 把裸标点映射为零宽锚点节点 / Map a bare punctuation character to its zero-width anchor node

params.rp: 正则解析器（命中时游标前进）/ Regex parser, whose cursor advances on a hit
params.c: 待判定的字符 / Character to classify

re_parse_anchor.return: `.`/`^`/`$` 对应 `RE_ANY`/`RE_BOL`/`RE_EOL` 节点，其它字符返回 `NULL` / An `RE_ANY`/`RE_BOL`/`RE_EOL` node for `.`, `^` and `$`, otherwise `NULL` for an ordinary literal

re_parse_atom.brief: 解析一个原子（分组、字符类、转义、锚点或字面）/ Parse one atom: group, class, escape, anchor or literal
re_parse_atom.return: 解析出的原子节点 / The parsed atom node
re_parse_atom.note: 字面字符按 UTF-8 解码为单码点 `RE_CHAR` / A literal character is UTF-8-decoded into a single-code-point `RE_CHAR`

re_parse_seq.brief: 解析一个并置序列（可带量词）/ Parse a concatenation sequence with optional quantifiers
re_parse_seq.return: 由若干原子构成的 `RE_SEQ` 节点 / The `RE_SEQ` node built from the atoms
re_parse_seq.details: 逐个解析原子并识别 `*`/`+`/`?`/`{n,m}` 量词，量词后紧跟 `?` 表示懒惰；遇 `|` 或 `)` 结束。| Atoms are parsed one by one, then `*`/`+`/`?`/`{n,m}` quantifiers are recognised with a trailing `?` meaning lazy; parsing stops at `|` or `)`.

re_parse_alt.brief: 解析 `|` 并集表达式 / Parse a `|` alternation expression
re_parse_alt.return: 只有一个分支时返回该序列，否则返回 `RE_ALT` 节点 / The single sequence when there is one branch, otherwise an `RE_ALT` node

re_set_cap.brief: 写入第 idx 个捕获组的字节区间 / Store the byte span of capture group idx

params.idx: 捕获组下标 / Capture group index
params.start: 起始字节偏移 / Start byte offset
params.end: 结束字节偏移 / End byte offset

re_set_cap.note: 下标越界（超出 `ncaps`）时静默忽略 / Out-of-range indices beyond `ncaps` are silently ignored

re_cap_get.brief: 读取第 idx 个捕获组的字节区间 / Read the byte span of capture group idx

params.idx: 捕获组下标 / Capture group index
params.start: out:接收起始字节偏移 / Receives the start byte offset
params.end: out:接收结束字节偏移 / Receives the end byte offset

re_cap_get.return: 该组已参与匹配返回 1，未设置或越界返回 0 / 1 when the group participated, 0 when unset or out of range

re_is_word.brief: 判断码点是否属于单词字符 / Test whether a code point counts as a word character
re_is_word.return: 为字母、数字、`_` 或非 ASCII 码点返回 1 / 1 for letters, digits, `_` or non-ASCII code points

re_decode_at.brief: 在指定字节位置解码一个 UTF-8 码点 / Decode one UTF-8 code point at a byte position

params.s: 主题字节串 / Subject byte string
params.len: 主题字节长度 / Subject byte length
params.pos: 解码起点字节偏移 / Start byte offset
params.out: out:接收解码出的码点 / Receives the decoded code point

re_decode_at.return: 该码点的字节宽度（至少 1），到串尾返回 0 / The byte width of the code point, at least 1, or 0 at the end of the subject
re_decode_at.note: 非法首字节输出 `0xFFFD` 且消耗 1 字节 / An illegal lead byte yields `0xFFFD` and consumes one byte

re_prev_cp.brief: 取某位置之前的码点 / Get the code point immediately before a position

params.s: 主题字节串 / Subject byte string
params.pos: 当前位置字节偏移 / Current byte offset

re_prev_cp.return: 前一个码点；位于串首时返回 0 / The previous code point, or 0 at the start of the subject
re_prev_cp.note: 回溯跳过 UTF-8 续字节以定位字符起点 / Continuation bytes are skipped backwards to find the character start

re_lower.brief: 把 ASCII 大写字母转小写 / Lower-case an ASCII uppercase letter
re_lower.return: 小写字符；非大写字母原样返回 / The lower-case character, or the input unchanged when it is not uppercase

re_single.brief: 判断单码点节点是否匹配该位置 / Test whether a single-code-point node matches at a position

params.n: 模式节点（`RE_CHAR`/`RE_ANY`/`RE_CLASS`）/ Pattern node, one of `RE_CHAR`, `RE_ANY`, `RE_CLASS`
params.pos: 待匹配字节偏移 / Byte offset to match at
params.adv: out:接收匹配字符的字节宽度 / Receives the matched character's byte width

re_single.return: 匹配返回 1，否则返回 0 / 1 on a match, otherwise 0
re_single.details: `RE_CHAR` 比较码点（`i` 标志下做 ASCII 折叠），`RE_ANY` 默认不匹配换行（`s` 标志下匹配），`RE_CLASS` 查区间并按 `negate` 取反。| `RE_CHAR` compares code points with ASCII folding under `i`, `RE_ANY` rejects newlines unless `s` is set and `RE_CLASS` scans the ranges, inverted when `negate` is set.

re_at_eol.brief: 判断是否处于行尾 / Test whether the position is at an end of line
re_at_eol.return: 串尾或（`m` 标志下）换行处返回 1 / 1 at the end of the subject or, under `m`, at a newline character

re_k_init.brief: 零初始化一个续延内核并链接后继 / Zero-initialise a continuation kernel and link it to the next one

params.k: out:待初始化的续延内核 / The continuation kernel to initialise
params.kind: 内核种类（`K_END`/`K_SEQ`/`K_REP`/`K_GROUP`）/ Kernel kind, one of `K_END`, `K_SEQ`, `K_REP`, `K_GROUP`
params.next: 后继内核，可为 `NULL` / The following kernel, may be `NULL`

re_k_init.note: 共享的字段默认值把 `target` 置为 -1，调用方只需覆盖各自用到的字段 / Shared defaults set `target` to -1 so callers only fill their own fields

re_cont_seq.brief: 推进序列内核到下一个元素 / Advance a sequence kernel to its next element

params.k: 续延内核（`K_SEQ`）/ The continuation kernel, `K_SEQ`
params.pos: 当前字节偏移 / Current byte offset

re_cont_seq.return: 匹配成功返回 1 / 1 when the match succeeds
re_cont_seq.note: 序列耗尽后转交给后继内核 / Hands off to the following kernel once the sequence is exhausted

re_cont_group.brief: 捕获组的续延：记录区间，失败时回滚 / Continuation for a captured group: record the span and roll it back on failure

params.k: 续延内核（`K_GROUP`）/ The continuation kernel, `K_GROUP`
params.pos: 当前字节偏移 / Current byte offset

re_cont_group.return: 匹配成功返回 1 / 1 when the match succeeds
re_cont_group.note: 后续匹配失败时恢复该组原有的区间 / The group's previous span is restored when the continuation fails

re_cont_rep.brief: 量词内核的续延：贪婪先试下一轮、懒惰先试余下模式 / Continuation for a repetition kernel: greedy retries, lazy tries the rest first

params.k: 续延内核（`K_REP`）/ The continuation kernel, `K_REP`
params.pos: 当前字节偏移 / Current byte offset

re_cont_rep.return: 匹配成功返回 1 / 1 when the match succeeds
re_cont_rep.note: `progressed` 防止无进展的循环体（如空匹配的 `*`）无限重复 / A progress guard stops an unbounded `*` over a body that consumes nothing from spinning forever

re_cont.brief: 续延分发：按内核种类恢复量词/分支 / Continuation dispatch: resume the scheduled quantifiers or branches by kernel kind

params.k: 续延内核，`NULL` 表示整段匹配成功 / The continuation kernel, `NULL` meaning the whole match succeeded
params.pos: 当前字节偏移 / Current byte offset

re_cont.return: 整体匹配成功返回 1 / 1 when the overall match succeeds
re_cont.note: 内核为 `NULL` 时把 `match_end` 置为该位置并返回成功 / A `NULL` kernel records `match_end` and reports success

re_rep_simple.brief: 单码点循环体的量词快速路径 / Fast path for quantifiers whose body consumes a single code point

params.k: 后继续延内核 / The following continuation kernel
params.pos: 起始字节偏移 / Starting byte offset

re_rep_simple.return: 匹配成功返回 1 / 1 when the match succeeds
re_rep_simple.details: 先迭代收集每个可能的停止位置，再按贪婪（从多到少）或懒惰（从少到多）依次尝试余下模式，从而保持递归深度较浅。| Iteratively collects every reachable stop position, then tries the rest of the pattern greedily from most to least or lazily from least to most, keeping recursion shallow.

re_backref.brief: 匹配反向引用 `\1`..`\9` / Match a back-reference `\1`..`\9`

params.n: 反向引用节点 / The back-reference node
params.k: 后继续延内核 / The following continuation kernel
params.pos: 当前字节偏移 / Current byte offset

re_backref.return: 匹配成功返回 1 / 1 when the match succeeds
re_backref.note: 被引用组未参与匹配时按空串处理；`i` 标志下逐字节做 ASCII 折叠 / An unset group matches the empty string; under `i` the bytes are ASCII-folded

re_assert.brief: 零宽断言：前瞻或后顾 / Zero-width assertion: look-ahead or look-behind

params.n: 环视节点（`RE_LOOK` 或 `RE_LBEHIND`）/ The look-around node, `RE_LOOK` or `RE_LBEHIND`
params.pos: 断言位置字节偏移 / Byte offset of the assertion

re_assert.return: 断言通过返回 1（否定断言取反）/ 1 when the assertion holds, inverted for a negative one
re_assert.details: 前瞻用 `K_END` 直接在该位置匹配；后顾尝试所有起始位置直到结束点等于 `pos`；捕获组保存与 `match_end` 在失败时恢复。| A look-ahead matches at the position with a `K_END` kernel; a look-behind tries every start offset until the end lands on `pos`; captures and `match_end` are restored on failure.

re_run_seq.brief: 匹配序列节点，并把余下元素排进 `K_SEQ` 内核 / Match a sequence node, scheduling the remaining elements through a `K_SEQ` kernel

params.k: 后继续延内核 / The following continuation kernel
params.pos: 当前字节偏移 / Current byte offset

re_run_seq.return: 匹配成功返回 1 / 1 when the match succeeds
re_run_seq.note: 空序列直接转交后继内核 / An empty sequence falls straight through to the following kernel

re_run_alt.brief: 依次尝试并集的各个分支 / Try each alternation branch in order

params.n: 并集节点（`RE_ALT`）/ The alternation node, `RE_ALT`
params.k: 后继续延内核 / The following continuation kernel
params.pos: 当前字节偏移 / Current byte offset

re_run_alt.return: 某分支成功返回 1 / 1 when one branch succeeds

re_run_rep.brief: 匹配量词节点 / Match a quantifier node

params.n: 量词节点（`RE_REP`）/ The quantifier node, `RE_REP`
params.k: 后继续延内核 / The following continuation kernel
params.pos: 当前字节偏移 / Current byte offset

re_run_rep.return: 匹配成功返回 1 / 1 when the match succeeds
re_run_rep.note: 最大次数为 0 时按最小次数直接成功或失败；单码点循环体走 `re_rep_simple` 快速路径，否则用 `K_REP` 内核 / A zero maximum succeeds or fails per the minimum count; single-code-point bodies take the `re_rep_simple` fast path and otherwise a `K_REP` kernel is used

re_run_group.brief: 匹配分组节点，捕获组记录起止区间 / Match a group node, recording the span for capturing groups

params.n: 分组节点（`RE_GROUP`）/ The group node, `RE_GROUP`
params.k: 后继续延内核 / The following continuation kernel
params.pos: 当前字节偏移 / Current byte offset

re_run_group.return: 匹配成功返回 1 / 1 when the match succeeds
re_run_group.note: 非捕获组仅递归子节点 / A non-capturing group just recurses into its child

re_run_wordb.brief: 匹配词边界断言 `\b` / `\B` / Match the word-boundary assertion `\b` or `\B`

params.n: 词边界节点（`RE_WORDB` 或 `RE_NWORDB`）/ The word-boundary node, `RE_WORDB` or `RE_NWORDB`
params.k: 后继续延内核 / The following continuation kernel
params.pos: 当前字节偏移 / Current byte offset

re_run_wordb.return: 断言通过返回 1 / 1 when the assertion holds
re_run_wordb.note: 比较该位置前后是否为单词字符，`\B` 取相反条件 / Compares word-character status before and after the position, with `\B` negating the condition

re_run_anchor.brief: 匹配 `^` / `$` 锚点 / Match the `^` and `$` anchors

params.n: 锚点节点（`RE_BOL` 或 `RE_EOL`）/ The anchor node, `RE_BOL` or `RE_EOL`
params.k: 后继续延内核 / The following continuation kernel
params.pos: 当前字节偏移 / Current byte offset

re_run_anchor.return: 锚点成立返回 1 / 1 when the anchor holds
re_run_anchor.note: 多行模式下 `^` 也匹配换行之后、`$` 匹配换行之前 / Under multi-line mode `^` also matches after a newline and `$` before one

re_run_single_node.brief: 匹配并消费一个单码点节点 / Match and consume a single-code-point node

params.n: 单码点节点（`RE_CHAR`/`RE_ANY`/`RE_CLASS`）/ A single-code-point node, one of `RE_CHAR`, `RE_ANY`, `RE_CLASS`
params.k: 后继续延内核 / The following continuation kernel
params.pos: 当前字节偏移 / Current byte offset

re_run_single_node.return: 匹配成功返回 1 / 1 when the match succeeds
re_run_single_node.note: 成功后按匹配字符的字节宽度推进 / The cursor advances by the matched character's byte width

re_node.brief: 匹配单个模式节点的统一入口 / Unified entry point for matching one pattern node

params.k: 后继续延内核 / The following continuation kernel
params.pos: 当前字节偏移 / Current byte offset

re_node.return: 匹配成功返回 1 / 1 when the match succeeds
re_node.details: 先递增步数与深度计数，超过 `RE_MAX_STEPS`/`RE_MAX_DEPTH` 即放弃以防回溯爆炸，再按节点类型分派到各 `re_run_*`。| Step and depth counters are bumped first — exceeding `RE_MAX_STEPS` or `RE_MAX_DEPTH` aborts to bound backtracking — then the node type dispatches to the matching `re_run_*` helper.

hpe_regex_group_count.brief: 返回正则的捕获组个数 / Return the number of capture groups

params.re: 正则对象，可为 `NULL` / Regex object, may be `NULL`

hpe_regex_group_count.return: 捕获组个数，`re` 为 `NULL` 时返回 0 / The capture group count, or 0 when `re` is `NULL`

hpe_regex_set_flags.brief: 从标志串解析 `/i /m /s` 开关 / Parse the `/i /m /s` switches from a flag string

params.re: inout:目标正则对象，可为 `NULL` / Target regex object, may be `NULL`
params.flags: 标志串，可为 `NULL` / Flag string, may be `NULL`

hpe_regex_set_flags.note: 先清零再逐字符置位（`i`=1、`m`=2、`s`=4）；`g` 由调用方处理 / The bit mask is cleared first, then `i`=1, `m`=2 and `s`=4 are set per character; `g` is handled by the caller

hpe_regex_compile.brief: 编译正则模式串为匹配程序 / Compile a regex pattern into a matcher program

params.js: JS 运行时上下文 / JS runtime context
params.pattern: 模式串，`NULL` 视为空模式 / Pattern string, `NULL` treated as empty

hpe_regex_compile.return: arena 中新建的正则对象 / The new regex object in the arena
hpe_regex_compile.note: 标志位初始为 0，需另行调用 `hpe_regex_set_flags` / Flags start at 0 and must be set later with `hpe_regex_set_flags`

hpe_regex_search.brief: 从指定位置起搜索主题串 / Search the subject starting from a given offset

params.re: 已编译的正则对象 / A compiled regex object
params.subject: 主题串，`NULL` 视为空串 / Subject string, `NULL` treated as empty
params.start: 起始字节偏移（负值夹为 0）/ Start byte offset, clamped to 0 when negative
params.captures: out:接收捕获组的字节偏移数组 / Receives the capture byte-offset array

hpe_regex_search.return: 匹配则返回匹配结束后的字节偏移，否则返回 -1 / The byte offset just past the match, or -1 when nothing matches
hpe_regex_search.details: `captures[0]/[1]` 为整段匹配，`[2+2g]/[3+2g]` 为第 g 个捕获组；未参与匹配的组置 -1。| `captures[0]`/`[1]` describe the whole match and `[2+2g]`/`[3+2g]` the g-th group; groups that did not participate are set to -1.
hpe_regex_search.note: 非多行模式下顶层 `^` 只可能在偏移 0 匹配，越过后提前退出 / A top-level `^` can only match at offset 0 outside multi-line mode, so the loop stops once past it

hpe_regex_match.brief: 判断主题串中是否存在匹配 / Test whether the subject contains a match

params.re: 已编译的正则对象 / A compiled regex object
params.subject: 主题串 / Subject string

hpe_regex_match.return: 找到匹配返回 1 / 1 when a match is found
hpe_regex_match.note: 内部用两个槽位接收整段匹配区间 / Uses a two-slot array to receive the whole-match span
